prerequisites: Basic mathematical concepts from high school or first semester courses

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the mechanisms of inheritance and polymorphism
Effectively use class inheritance and polymorphism in solving a simple problem
Effectively use exceptions in solving a simple problem
Effectively use defined input/output classes for reading binary and text files
Define the necessary unit tests to validate an application using standard mechanisms

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the Object-Oriented Programming Paradigm

assessment_methods.method: Practical test (HP) on inheritance and polymorphism
Practical test (EF) on exceptions and file handling

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required for the theoretical block and for each practical test (HP and EF). The final practical grade is calculated as (0.8 × HP) + (0.2 × EF). The final grade is (0.5 × Theory) + (0.5 × Practicals) if minimums are met, otherwise it is the minimum of 4.0 and the calculated grade. For extraordinary calls, a minimum of 5 out of 10 points is required for TE, HP, and EF, and the final grade is (0.5 × TE) + (0.4 × HP) + (0.1 × EF). If minimums are not met, the final grade is the minimum of 4.0 and the calculated grade. The final grade may be increased by up to 20% by evaluating theoretical exercises and practical assignments, only if all assessment tests have been passed.
